verdict: Lead flow is steady at a fair cost, and October's furnace season is about to amplify it.
diagnosis: You spent $11,182 on Instagram and got 78 leads this period — about $143 per lead, right at the industry line for paid social.

signals.headline: 78 leads at $143 each
signals.detail: Instagram furnace campaign delivered 78 leads for $11,182 spent. Cost per lead sits near the paid search benchmark.

signals.headline: 348 new reviews, 5.0 stars
signals.detail: Review volume is exceptional this period and the rating held perfect. This is the strongest trust signal you have.

signals.headline: 98 call clicks, 180 directions
signals.detail: Google Business Profile drove 278 high-intent actions. These are near-ready buyers, not browsers.

signals.headline: 266,796 impressions, 1,278 link clicks
signals.detail: Reach is wide but click-through is thin. The furnace creative is getting seen more than it is getting acted on.

signals.headline: 224 new Instagram followers
signals.detail: Follower growth doubled the account to 350. Audience is building ahead of peak heating season.

benchmark.label: Benchmark
benchmark.subheader: Your lead cost sits in the normal range
benchmark.body: HVAC paid search averages $104 per lead blended, with non-branded search hitting $149. Your $143 Instagram cost per lead is competitive, though Google Local Services Ads run cheaper at roughly $51.

seasonal.label: Seasonal
seasonal.body: Furnace repair searches peak 137% above baseline heading into January. October specifically spikes because dormant furnaces fail on first startup. Demand is about to rise sharply in your market.

competitor.label: Competitor
competitor.subheader: 76% of HVAC firms report rising demand
competitor.body: 91% of HVAC contractors are booked or near full, and 73% report larger job sizes than last year. Competition for installs is intensifying as heat pump adoption accelerates.

recommendations.title: Test Google Local Services Ads alongside Instagram
recommendations.detail: Local Services Ads average $51 per lead for HVAC with a 44% book rate. Worth testing a small budget to compare against your current $143 Instagram cost.

recommendations.title: Push the furnace tune-up offer harder in October
recommendations.detail: First cold snap triggers a 2.8x spike in heating calls. Consider front-loading spend now while intent is climbing and before competitors flood the auction.

recommendations.title: Feature your 5-star reviews in the ad creative
recommendations.detail: You added 348 reviews this period at a perfect rating. Test ad variants that quote recent reviewers to lift click-through on the furnace campaign.
